title: Slice 622414: [SOA] [Pioneer] Enhancing Sales Order Agent with Item Variant : availability and prices
summary: The Sales Order Agent now resolves customer requests to a specific item variant and uses it for availability, pricing and quote or order creation. Variant alternatives are kept only when classified as safe, and Variant Code stays empty when no variant was requested. If no suitable variant is available, the agent tells the customer and does not create a quote.
key_points: Item Selector now runs consistently for all search result types and includes variant code in its output with safety classifications
Variant alternatives are retained only when explicitly classified as safe, preserving form, fit, function, and safety
Availability checks, pricing, shipment dates, and quote creation now use the resolved variant code
Valid empty variant selections are treated as authoritative with no fallback to original candidates
Telemetry emits stable failure categories and aggregate counts without exposing customer content or raw errors
quote: The agent can now resolve a customer request to a specific item and variant, use that variant when checking availability and calculating prices.
